# Rayhan's Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and blog by Rayhan — a software engineer writing about frontend development, web tooling, and occasional non-tech topics. Also showcases personal projects and book/film reviews.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rayhannr.dev): Portfolio landing page
- [About](https://rayhannr.dev/about): About Rayhan
- [Blog](https://rayhannr.dev/blog): All blog posts
- [Projects](https://rayhannr.dev/project): All personal projects
- [Reviews](https://rayhannr.dev/review): Book and film reviews
